title: Orchid Assembly
description: The opening lower voice calls a small ensemble into being. A delayed upper answer grows into an extended duet; two new middle voices then create an eight-bar quartet. After its crest the extra voices leave, and the original pair finds a more spacious common ending.
technical_note: Give the four central lines separate direction while keeping both hands within an octave at every held instant. The RH melody stays above its moving inner voice; the LH tenor sings over sustained bass. Finger legato, restrained pedal and carefully weighted chord tops are essential.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
